title: digitalcorpora.org Terms of Use / About page
summary: digitalcorpora.org hosts CC-MAIN-2021-31-PDF-UNTRUNCATED, GovDocs1 and NapierOne mirrors; states research-use terms and that files were collected from public web crawls / public-domain government sources.

title: unicode.org UDHR project decommission notice
summary: States: 'The Unicode Consortium is no longer hosting the UDHR in Unicode project. Translations ... are available on the United Nations site ... OHCHR.' Former data-file paths (unicode.org/udhr/d/udhr_eng.txt, .../assemblies/udhr_txt.zip, .../unaccented/udhr_eng.txt) all return 404: the corpus itself has been decommissioned there, not merely access-restricted.

title: NapierOne dataset entry, AWS Registry of Open Data
summary: NapierOne mixed-file-type dataset (incl. PDF). License: Edinburgh Napier University License Agreement, 'free, full and open access ... free to Copy, publish, distribute and transmit the Information; Adapt the Information; Exploit the Information commercially and non-commercially'. S3 ARN arn:aws:s3:::napierone.com, region eu-north-1, unsigned CLI access (aws s3 ls --no-sign-request s3://napierone.com/), no AWS account required.

title: DFRWS 2007 Forensic Carving Challenge README
summary: DFRWS 2007 challenge extended DFRWS 2006 with more file types and more complex fragmentation scenarios; winner (M. Cohen) built dedicated fragment-validators for PDF, ZIP, MIME, HTML and MPEG based on a theory of file mapping and fragmentation.

title: enssec/squashfs_bitflip_repair README
summary: README states the project is 'mostly Apache license ... see LICENSE file'; the LICENSE file itself is not present at the repository root (404), so the exact license text is unconfirmed.

title: radamsa LICENCE (gitlab.com/akihe/radamsa)
summary: MIT license: 'Copyright (c) 2013 Aki Helin ... Permission is hereby granted, free of charge...'. Confirmed by cloning and building from source in-container (bin/radamsa, version string 'Radamsa 0.8a').

title: peepdf-3 COPYING (bundled in PyPI package)
summary: The installed pip package peepdf_3-5.4.1 ships licenses/COPYING containing the full GNU GPL v3 text. Copyleft: peepdf-3 may be run as an external CLI tool, but its code must never be pasted or vendored into PDFPundit (clean-room rule).

title: dfxml_python LICENSE.md
summary: 'CC0 1.0 / LGPL Fusion Universal Summary -- This software is a work of the Naval Postgraduate School (NPS) and the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST). As a work of the US Government...' Dual CC0-1.0/LGPL, US-government work. Not published on PyPI under 'dfxml' or 'dfxml-python'; installs from git+https://github.com/dfxml-working-group/dfxml_python.git as package 'dfxml' v1.0.2.

title: UCO ontology repository (ucoProject/UCO)
summary: Unified Cyber Ontology (UCO), the successor/companion ontology to CASE (same casework community). Tags up to 1.5.0 confirmed via git ls-remote --tags (2026-09-27); companion CASE repo (casework/CASE) is Apache-2.0 licensed and also at tag 1.5.0, and the two share a license.

title: Arlington PDF Model repository (pdf-association/arlington-pdf-model)
summary: Machine-readable, grammar-style PDF object model (TSV) plus TestGrammar C++ conformance checker. Apache-2.0 licensed.

title: RUB-NDS pdf-attacker repository
summary: Companion artefacts for the PDF shadow-attack / signature-attack line of research (incremental-update-based attacks). Default branch 'master' confirmed via git ls-remote. No LICENSE file at the repository root on that branch (raw fetch 404s for both README.md at 'main', which does not exist, and LICENSE at 'master', which does), so the code is all-rights-reserved by default; may be studied/cited by description but not vendored.

title: Common Crawl data.commoncrawl.org access (observed 403, 2026-09-27)
summary: Direct experience in this container: a Range request to a data.commoncrawl.org WARC segment (the same access pattern OBS-0201 used successfully in an earlier session) returned HTTP 403 Forbidden today, with no proxy-level relay failure recorded (confirmed via $HTTPS_PROXY/__agentproxy/status), i.e. the TCP/TLS connection succeeded and Common Crawl's own origin returned the 403. Per standing instruction this was not probed further (no UA/retry workaround attempted).

title: SafeDocs Issue Tracker corpus description (digitalcorpora)
summary: Confirms the corpora/files/ prefix on the digitalcorpora S3 bucket lists top-level corpus directories including CC-MAIN-2021-31-PDF-UNTRUNCATED; used to navigate without an AWS account via the unsigned S3 ListObjectsV2 XML API (?list-type=2&prefix=...).
